facts.note: How far the bier is carried in the open before the road divides. Long enough that the party settles into somebody else's pace and starts listening to the two mourners; short enough that it is not the whole delve.
Each road out of the fork, stone to shoulder. The two are the same length on purpose: neither is the shorter way, so the choice cannot be made on convenience.
The plane of the sunken road, three below the coast he saved. The low way goes down into standing water and climbs back out, and the descent is the argument the other road never has to make.
The plane the keepers' barrow stands on. Both roads climb the last five together, so the party arrives out of breath whichever way it came.
The keepers' ground across. Room for a procession to stand around one grave and no more.
